newsitem.title: UK: UK's Internet Technology Group to list on AIM.
newsitem.headline: UK's Internet Technology Group to list on AIM.

text.p: Internet Technology Group Plc said on Tuesday dealings in its shares will begin on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) on October 11.
"This is an important step in the development of Internet Technology," said chief executive Laurence Blackall.
"It will facilitate the investment needed in order to grow the company and increase our subscriber base."

After the listing Internet Technology, formerly Capital & Western Estates, plans to dispose of its property interests, investing the proceeds in the expansion of its internet business and in further strategic acquisitions in the technology sector.
Internet Technology was set up when Capital & Western Estates Plc completed the takeover of Ballynatray, a small property company, and its acquisition of Global Internet, an internet access provider.
Capital and Western, which was listed on AIM until its offer for Ballynatray was announced on August 13, changed its name to Internet Technology on September 17.
